_comment: This app's actual CORS behavior, as implemented in services/platform/runtime.js (shared by every JavaScript service). Recorded here so a future portable CORS check has a concrete, real value to diff against, and so SEC-01's defect #4 (overly broad CORS) can be verified absent from the real build, not just assumed absent.
allowedOrigin: process.env.FRONTEND_ORIGIN, default http://localhost:3000 — checked for exact equality before being echoed back, never a wildcard
verifiedAgainstRealImplementation: 2026-10-03, manual read of services/platform/runtime.js — not yet confirmed by a scanner run
